data.script: Sofia: My favourite animal is the kangaroo. It can jump three metres in one hop! … Sofia: And the baby travels in the mother's pocket. First class ticket! … Mateo: Mine is the cat. It can sleep twenty hours a day. My hero! … Sofia: Erik chose the parrot. His uncle's parrot can say fourteen words. … Mateo: Including PIZZA. It's a very smart parrot. … Sofia: And Valentina loves the dolphin, because it can jump and it always smiles. … Mateo: Best show and tell ever. Next week: favourite dinosaurs!
